fact: Taarifa reports Prime Minister Nsengiyumva attributing a fall in fraud complaints to regulations and mechanisms introduced to prevent fraud, resolve complaints and recover misappropriated funds.
Governor Hakuziyaremye says Rwanda's consumer-protection framework requires failed transfers to be refunded in a timely manner.
BNR says users with unresolved payment problems can contact it through social media or the Intumwa chatbot so it can establish what happened and whether to refund.
NBR says customers with unresolved eKash problems may complain to the National Bank of Rwanda through the Intumwa chatbot by SMS, WhatsApp, website and social media.
Proto says the National Bank of Rwanda's Intumwa AI agent, deployed in 2021, processes complaints across more than 600 financial institutions and was being expanded as of November 2025.
